meta.price_convention: Prices are taken ~60 days after each quarter-end (e.g. the 31-Mar row uses 1-Jun and 1-Sep prices), so a quarter's return is earned over the following quarter with a 60-day entry lag.
meta.portfolio: Top N by model rank, equal weight, rebalanced each quarter; price returns, no dividends, costs or slippage.
meta.in_sample_note: Quarters up to and including a model's training cut-off were in its training data; their returns are flattered because the model has seen those outcomes. The BiLSTM was trained through Dec-2021 (its honest out-of-sample record starts with the Mar-2022 scoring date); the baseline models were trained through Dec-2020. Use in-sample windows to see how a model fits history, not to judge skill.
meta.benchmark_note: nifty50/quality30/momentum30/value30 are NIFTY index price returns on the same lagged dates where available; null where not yet supplied. universe_ew (equal-weight average of every scored stock) is available for every quarter.
meta.comparison_note: Baseline models (Logistic, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM) were trained on the same 11 features and the same 64 training quarters (to Dec-2020) as the BiLSTM and scored out-of-sample from Mar-2021; they have no in-sample quarters, so earlier windows show only the BiLSTM.
meta.notes_dec25: The 31-Dec-2025 scoring quarter (Q3 FY26) was scored on 28-Sep-2026 with the frozen BiLSTM weights and the published OOT recipe from the Q3_FY_26 input file; returns use closes on 2-Mar-2026 and 1-Jun-2026 (same 60-day lag). Baseline models have no row for this quarter yet.
